game_concept: A racing platformer set in Mystic Forest – Lantern Path, a lantern-lit path: the herbalist must handle mischievous sprites while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Range Runner: Run a for i in range(n) loop so the herbalist moves exactly n steps toward the mushroom ring.
theme: Mystic Forest – Lantern Path: a lantern-lit path
core_gameplay_loop: In Lantern Path, repeat each round: Run a for i in range(n) loop so the herbalist moves exactly n steps toward the mushroom ring. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the herbalist ahead. Then check the steps_left value and advance.
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the mushroom ring by solving code steps involving steps_left that move the herbalist forward.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.85).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the mushroom ring first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 5 – Control Flow: For Loops | Level 8 (extended tier): Range Runner
assets_style: lush pixel-art forest: dense green canopy, a glowing blue ancient tree, winding streams and dirt paths; flat Kenney-style sprites; airy flutes, birdsong and soft magical chimes
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Range Runner' (Week 5 slot 1), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Lantern Path'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mystic Forest
region.mood: airy flutes, birdsong and soft magical chimes

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how steps_left changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against mischievous sprites in Lantern Path.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.85).
